address: Gulberg III, Lahore (head office; the site does not give a full street address)

export_evidence: Per the user's files: Volza shows 10- and 12-inch pizza box shipments to the UK in 2024/25. Not re-verified (403).
correction: Your files list City Tower, Main Boulevard as the address, but the site shows only 'Gulberg III, Lahore'. Paper Bag should not be mapped (base paper only). Corrugated box making is a recent addition, so ask about capacity.

evidence: Rotogravure, offset ('cardboard boxes'), LDPE extrusion and 'corrugation packaging solution for heavy and bulk packaging'. Mostly a flexible-packaging converter for FMCG clients. Pizza is mapped from export records only.

correction: The site's copyright is 2018 and it looks stale. Confirm the company is still active and has corrugation capacity.

name: SASA Packaging

name: S.H. Packages

certifications: Site claims ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and FSC CoC. Not validated.

name: Packages Convertors
evidence: Wholly owned subsidiary of Packages Limited; since the 2020 restructuring it holds the group's converting business (folding cartons, flexible packaging, tissue). None of its published products directly match our lines.
export_evidence: Per the user's files: Trademo shows 444 export shipments through Sep 2025, including packaging bags, to Canada, South Africa and Sri Lanka. Not re-verified.
certifications: Per the user's files the ISO 9001 PDF on the site expired on 23 Oct 2024. Ask for the current certificate.
correction: Site blocks automated access, so info@packages.com.pk could not be confirmed. Sister company of Bulleh Shah Packaging under Packages Ltd; treat as one counterparty group.

name: Bulleh Shah Packaging
address: Mill and corrugator in Kasur; corporate contact through the Packages Group in Lahore; offices also in Karachi and Islamabad
evidence: Integrated paper and board mill and corrugated box maker: about 240,000 t of paper and board and 210m corrugated boxes a year. Serves textiles, dairy, snacks and electronics; makes 'fluting with moisture barrier for packaging of fruit'.
export_evidence: Per the user's files: Trademo shows 417 export shipments through Sep 2025 (incl. HS 481910) to the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Oman; much of it paperboard. On the TDAP top-exporter listing. Not re-verified.
certifications: PACRA entity rating AA-/A1, stable (Sep 2024) — a credit rating, not a quality certificate.
correction: Site blocks automated access. PaperAdvance cites 330m boxes and 450,000 t vs 210m on the company page; confirm which is current. Sister company of Packages Convertors under Packages Ltd.

name: Saima Packaging
